items.description: Report states the remainder is amount % 1e10 and is lost per call, but the predicate grammar has no modulo operator; the remainder-retention relation is carried as a grounded Boolean whose meaning states the modulo remainder retention, with the numeric modulo definition recorded here for stage-3 binding.

Report does not give a numeric definition of the accounting buckets (totalStaked, hypeBuffer, delegated amount) needed to express the outside-accounting relation numerically; only the qualitative outside-accounting condition is stated.
Report does not state whether the stranded remainder sits in an ETH balance or an L1 account, so the storage location of the outside-accounting value is unspecified.
